hero.title:
Every material an agent needs,
laid out in one plaza.
hero.lead: Packs, ecosystem skills, MCP servers, AI facades, official data anchors — every one of them something a human or an AI agent can understand, obtain, and run. This site shows what exists, how it is supplied, and what is here right now.
hero.actions: Human: read on, or jump to the inventory

materials.title: What materials exist
materials.lead: Everything the plaza offers is a material. Material is the genus — the five species below differ in shape and share one supply mechanism.

items.name: Pack
items.desc: A versioned bundle of skills, MCP references, and personas. Publishing freezes an immutable snapshot; install it and it works. One pack is one deliverable capability.
items.example: Example: the CRM Service Desk Suite — connect your own service desk, read conversations, draft replies, send after confirmation.

items.name: Ecosystem Skill
items.desc: Open-community skills admitted through review: carrying source and license marks, installable alone or composed into packs.
items.example: Example: individual skills inside the data-ingestion and document-studio shelves.

items.name: MCP Server
items.desc: Tool services a model can call. Every entry carries a two-way annotation — humans read five-locale summaries, AI reads the canonical brief; one annotation layer, speaking to each reader in its own language.
items.example: Example: Web fetch — pull any URL's content with zero configuration.

items.name: AI Facade
items.desc: A reception persona frozen with its corpus: chat with the facade to learn about its principal; anything uncovered is honestly declined, never invented. Deployable as a standing conversation service — visitors free, the principal pays.
items.example: Example: the FindData facade — ask it about the company, running projects, and capabilities.

items.name: Official Data Anchor
items.desc: The official shelf anchored on FindData's own data MCPs: macro, financial, and city-panel sources with cited sources and periods, composable into packs.
items.example: Example: the city panel — 209 indicators × 297 cities × 2000–2024.

mechanism.title: How it is supplied
mechanism.lead: A four-segment mechanism chain, each segment told from the material's perspective: what it does to your material, and what it guarantees.
mechanism.link: The same table in machine-readable form: /generated/infrastructure.md

steps.input: A pack manifest (skills + MCP references + personas)
steps.output: One immutable version snapshot on the market
steps.promise: A published version can never be rewritten; unpublishing never destroys installed snapshots.

steps.input: Five-editor CLI / the in-product market / the market page
steps.output: One frozen snapshot installed into your runtime
steps.promise: All three paths land the same snapshot; installation is per-pack and explicit; anonymous browsing is allowed.

steps.input: The installed snapshot + one user cell
steps.output: Personas and tool surfaces running in isolation
steps.promise: Cells are invisible to each other; tool allowlists narrow the context to what is needed.

steps.input: A persona with a serving contract + the deployer's billing key
steps.output: A standing A2A conversation service (own endpoint and identity)
steps.promise: Residency survives idle periods; calls settle per use.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.lead: A live gallery: the page refreshes from the market on load; when unreachable it falls back to the build-time snapshot, with the as-of date always visible.
inventory.snapshot: Live refresh unreachable — showing the build-time snapshot

audience.title: Who it is for
audience.lead: This site is itself two-way: every piece of content speaks to humans and to AI agents at once.

human.title: If you are human
items: Editor user (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, ZCode): one command installs it into your editor.
Yizuo user: subscribe and install from the built-in market, credentials pre-wired.
Creator: organize your knowledge into a manifest and publish — the Facade Builder interviews you and generates it.

ai.title: If you are an AI agent
items: Start at /generated/llms.txt: the site index, every section self-contained.
Structured data at /generated/catalog.json: canonical brief + five-locale summaries + whenToUse + provenance.
One self-contained Markdown page per material (materials/<slug>.md), addresses stable across content updates.
To turn a material into a live service: the A2A endpoint — see the Serve row in infrastructure.md.

footer.tagline: The materials overview humans and AI read together
